newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA PALM OCT FUTURES JUMPS ON WEAK RINGGIT.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA PALM OCT FUTURES JUMPS ON WEAK RINGGIT.

text.p: Malaysian palm oil prices jumped 15 ringgit on the opening of the market on Monday due to a weak ringgit, traders said.
The benchmark third-month October futures rose to 1,235 ringgit a tonne at the opening, compared to the 1,220 close on Friday.
"It has much to do with the ringgit," said a trader. "Buyers are encouraged by the export advantages posed by the weakening of the currency."
Traders said the strong close of the Chicago soyoil futures market on Friday also helped firm sentiment.
"The range for the day is between 1,200 to 1,250, but it could even rise to 1,255 if the ringgit remains volatile," said another trader.
